name: @lango-project/lango-server
description: A small JSON HTTP server for Lango applications.

scripts.build: lango run tools/clean.lango && lango build src/library.lango --out dist/library.mjs && lango build src/server.lango --out dist/cli/server.mjs --executable && lango build src/worker.lango --out dist/worker.mjs && lango build examples/application/handlers.lango --out examples/application/dist/handlers.mjs && lango build src/postgres_worker.lango --out dist/postgres_worker.mjs && lango build examples/database/handlers.lango --out examples/database/dist/handlers.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && lango build src/test/handlers.lango --out .test-output/handlers.mjs && lango build src/test/sql_handlers.lango --out .test-output/sql_handlers.mjs && lango build src/test/middleware_handlers.lango --out .test-output/middleware_handlers.mjs && lango test src/test/database.lango --build-dir .test-output/database && lango test src/test/unit.lango --build-dir .test-output/unit && lango test src/test/route_parameters.lango --build-dir .test-output/route-parameters && lango test src/test/http.lango --build-dir .test-output/http && lango test src/test/middleware.lango --build-dir .test-output/middleware && lango test src/test/static.lango --build-dir .test-output/static && lango test src/test/standalone.lango --build-dir .test-output/standalone
scripts.test:postgres: lango build src/test/sql_handlers.lango --out .test-output/sql_handlers.mjs && lango test src/test/database.lango --build-dir .test-output/database-postgres
scripts.test:longpoll: lango build src/test/longpoll_handlers.lango --out .test-output/longpoll_handlers.mjs && lango test src/test/longpoll.lango --build-dir .test-output/longpoll && lango build src/test/middleware_handlers.lango --out .test-output/middleware_handlers.mjs && lango test src/test/standalone.lango --build-dir .test-output/standalone-longpoll
scripts.test:middleware: lango build src/test/handlers.lango --out .test-output/handlers.mjs && lango build src/test/middleware_handlers.lango --out .test-output/middleware_handlers.mjs && lango test src/test/middleware.lango --build-dir .test-output/middleware
